2) The portal reports a duplicate account for our domain (it suggests an existing account exists but we don't have credentials).

Hi Samira — thanks for the detail and the files.

Short answer: yes, we can manually provision a vendor record and push a password reset link so you can finish profile completion. Before we do that, please run through the attached vendor intake checklist so we have the required fields captured for Finance and Compliance. I've attached the checklist and put the high-impact items below:

- Legal entity name (exact)
- VAT / Tax ID (format + country)
- W-8/W-9 or local tax form (if applicable)
- Bank details (IBAN/SWIFT) + remittance email
- Primary contact + phone and authorized signer

If you prefer we can also escalate to the portal provider (Ivalua) if the VAT validator itself is returning an upstream error. If you share the portal username you'd like to be associated, we can check for collisions and either merge or create a new account.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm the four bullets above via reply or upload to the Drive link I shared.
2) If VAT still fails, we open a support case with Ivalua and in parallel I create the vendor record (manual) so Finance can issue a PO.

I'll loop in Laura (vendor ops) and Priyom (vendor onboarding) to help triage.

Attachment: redwood_vendor_intake_checklist.pdf

Regards,
Markus Klein
